acceptanceCriteria.text: Queue wake callbacks do not throw when Chrome invalidates the context synchronously or asynchronously.
Invalidated bridge cancels automation timers and cannot reschedule them; normal queue/energy and ordinary failure behavior is preserved.
Regression tests, typecheck and versioned build pass and changes are committed.

checkpointPayload.description: Fix uncaught synchronous Extension context invalidated from building timer at bridge.js395. Safely dispatch all bridge automation wake timers, stop and prevent rescheduling after invalidation, retain normal wake-up behavior and cover synchronous throws and asynchronous rejection.
checkpointPayload.implementationPlan: 1. Reproduce the exact timer synchronous throw and inspect bridge lifecycle. 2. Add shared guarded automation dispatch with invalidation teardown for all queue/energy wake timers and suppress stale callback rescheduling. 3. Run timer regressions and full checks, capture root cause, update version/changelog/build and commit.
